ask: mkae a pol for the dates plz
sentence: A group poll where each person taps every cabin weekend they can do, with live vote counts per weekend and a line showing how close the top weekend is to the needed yeses.
use_when: Picking a date for a group trip from a few fixed weekends
Checking which dates work for most people in the chat
Needing a set number of yeses before locking in a date
Letting people mark more than one date they can do
dont_use_when: Choosing a single option where each person gets only one vote
Finding a free time slot on a calendar by hour
Splitting costs or tracking who owes what
Polling on custom dates or options not already set
